title: Porcelain pour-over coffee dripper
short_description: Wheel-thrown porcelain dripper sized for a single mug. Conical interior with three spiral grooves.
long_description:
A pour-over dripper thrown in porcelain, fired to a translucent white. The conical interior has three spiral grooves to channel water evenly through the filter.

Fits standard #2 paper filters.

## Care

Hand wash with warm water; the porcelain is unglazed on the underside so dishwasher detergent can leave marks over time.
